title: THE FLOW MARKS ARE BUILT ONCE A FRAME
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 30): the marks of the raid flow (fires, events, strongholds) were built from scratch twice in every frame, once for the minimap and once for the sector map. They are now built once for each raid time and shared, since the state they read stands still while the frame is drawn.
now: The flow marks are now built once a frame and shared by the minimap and the sector map.
